name: Shin'yuu no Okaa-san ~Miboujin Ikenai Jouji~
original_name: 親友のお母さん～未亡人・いけない情事～
source:
Yui's husband passed away a while ago, and she has brought up her son, Shinji, by herself. One day, Shinji brings his friend, Touji, to his house. Yui gets sexually excited when she meets Touji, and induces him....
